Faculty review: MNzz (Dr. Mohammad Nuruzzaman)
Course: Pol202 (Introduction to IR)
Also recommended for: Pol101
As for open elective course(s), I had only left 6 credit to complete from my dept. As a geopolitics enthusiast, I found this course as a very first choice of mine, to complete it as an open elective, and it also made me regretful thinking why NSU doesn’t provide major in political science! The course is oriented with global political issues, international politics, global market, theories of war and so on. His teaching method is very smooth. You may ask how? Well, he teaches the topics like telling the stories. Topics are filled with examples and real-life incidents. Three quizzes (of which best 2 counts), one policy brief, one assignment, one mid and a final.
Tricks: Try to pull out as much as possible from the quizzes. The real real challenges comes from the 'policy briefing' part. Once you get to clarify it, you’d be able to pull up a good grade. Sir gives bonus marks so you have to be very stable in your mid term as well as the Final exam. The assignments are individual and the formats are provided by him on canvas.
Personal experience: Ended up with an A-. Ask me anything regarding problems and I'll try to give feedbacks as much as possible. 
Peace!
